description.fallback: Shikamaru begins to feel the pressure of shouldering the lives of his friends in the upcoming Fourth Shinobi World War. To help ease his mind, Shikaku sends his son along with Tenten on a mission to Mokuzu Island to replenish supplies. On the island, Shikamaru meets up with Naruto's group.

intro.fallback: Shikamaru begins to feel the pressure of shouldering the lives of his friends in the upcoming Fourth Shinobi World War.
To help ease his mind, Shikaku sends his son along with Tenten on a mission to Mokuzu Island to replenish supplies.
On the island, Shikamaru meets up with Naruto's group.

outro.fallback: The criminal, on seeing the ship wrecked, arrives at the spot with his gang to loot the wreckage.
Having stored the ship in Tenten's scroll, they proceed to defeat the criminals.
